items.title: De piepjonge bondscoach Frank Rijkaard: 'Ik dacht, waarom niet?'
items.summary: In de rubriek VI Tijdmachine brengen we met regelmaat nieuwe verhalen over toen, en elke dag van het weekeinde herplaatsen we een artikel uit ons rijke archief. Deze keer reizen we terug naar de herfst van 1998, toen Frank Rijkaard zijn eerste grote interview gaf als bondscoach.

items.title: 'Chelsea kaapt succesvolle Schotse specialist weg bij Aston Villa'
items.summary: Vijf jaar lang was Austin MacPhee het brein achter de standaardsituaties van Aston Villa, maar de specialist staat op het punt om The Villans te verlaten. Chelsea gaat namelijk de afkoopclausle van 46-jarige Schot lichten. Dat nieuws bracht onder meer The Athletic naar buiten.

items.title: Grand Slam-kampioen gaat aan de slag op achtste niveau in Oostenrijk
items.summary: De naam Dominic Thiem zal het voetballandschap wellicht niet enorm veel zeggen, maar dat kan de komende jaren weleens veranderen. De Grand Slam-kampioen gaat namelijk een nieuwe carrière als voetballer tegemoet.

items.title: Meteen domper voor Emegha in eerste weken bij Chelsea
items.summary: Emmanuel Emegha is vrijdag niet in het vliegtuig gestapt met Chelsea voor de oefentrip door Australië en Azië. De 23-jarige spits is met een blessure achtergebleven in Engeland.

items.title: 'Real maakt werk van komst Rodri en richt pijlen op Diomandé'
items.summary: De meeste transferwindows zijn geopend en dus neemt het transfernieuws weer toe. Traditiegetrouw volgt Voetbal International de buitenlandse markt op de voet. Bekijk hier ons blog voor de transferperikelen in Nederland.

items.title: Transfer news: Newcastle sign Monaco’s Bamba, Summerville joins Al-Hilal
items.summary: Midfielder agrees five-year contract after £34m move Dutch winger leaves West Ham in deal worth £60m Newcastle have made Aladji Bamba their fourth signing of the summer after the 20-year-old midfielder ­completed a move from Monaco for a fee that could rise to £34m. “I’m very happy to be here,” said Bamba. “I was very excited when I heard Newcastle were interested in signing me. I know about the ­history of the club and I’ve visited the ­stadium, which is amazing. I can’t wait to be on the pitch.” Continue reading...

items.title: Dismissed solicitor is still acting for footballers in brain injury court case
items.summary: Richard Boardman dropped by group of rugby players Football group includes family of Nobby Stiles The solicitor dismissed by a group of over 1,000 rugby players with brain injuries who are suing the sport’s governing bodies is still leading a similar claim on behalf of dozens of former footballers. Richard Boardman told a hearing at the Royal Courts of Justice this week of his intention to “come off the record,” with the claimants indicating that they had unanimously agreed to terminate their dealings with his firm, Rylands Garth. Continue reading...

items.title: West Ham winger Summerville joins Al-Hilal
items.summary: West Ham confirm the sale of Netherlands winger Crysencio Summerville to Saudi club Al-Hilal.

items.title: ‘You need to evolve’: Enzo Maresca plots life after Pep at Manchester City
items.summary: Italian does not shy away from the task of following a legend but his previous time at the club may help him Relaxed and tanned, Enzo Maresca offered a warm note with his first words to the media as the manager of Manchester City, who must somehow follow the generational Pep Guardiola. “Before we start, I would like to send a message and a big hug to Kevin Keegan’s family for this moment,” said the Italian in tribute to a football legend, following his death on Monday. Keegan, of course, was a former City manager who had at Newcastle famously locked horns with Sir Alex Ferguson when he led Manchester United, the fierce rivals of Maresca’s new team. When the 46-year-old, sat on the dais occupied for 10 mostly glittering years by Guardiola, offered an unsolicited reference to Ferguson – and Arsène Wenger – you could see he comprehended the mammoth task before him. Continue reading...

items.title: IOC says Infantino complaint outside its scope
items.summary: The IOC says it will not investigate Gianni Infantino as a complaint about the Fifa president is "outside" its scope.

items.title: Rodri to have back surgery but Maresca brushes off transfer speculation
items.summary: World Cup winner Rodri is to have back surgery, says new Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca.

items.title: Jürgen Klopp vows to change Germany but threatens to quit if family hounded by media
items.summary: Suggests role will be his final job in top-level football Warns journalists to ‘leave my family in peace’ Jürgen Klopp said he wants his team to “change a country” after being confirmed as Germany’s new head coach, but threatened to stand down if his family are hounded by the media during his time in charge. In a forthright first press conference upon his unveiling as Julian Nagelsmann’s replacement, Klopp also suggested the role will be his final job in top-level football and expressed regret after poking fun at his predecessor while working as a television pundit during the World Cup. He is tasked with reviving Germany, who lost to Paraguay in the last 32 and have not made the last 16 since winning the tournament in 2014. Continue reading...

items.title: Andoni Iraola backs backroom staff to help cure Liverpool’s set-piece ills
items.summary: Tommy Elphick and Shaun Cooper to work on set-pieces Iraola felt ‘very lucky’ to work with them at Bournemouth Andoni Iraola has outlined the roles his backroom staff will play in trying to improve Liverpool’s set-piece record next season and admitted he was “very lucky” to inherit a talented coaching team at Bournemouth. Iraola has brought several members of his Bournemouth backroom team with him to Liverpool since succeeding Arne Slot last month. Tommy Elphick, a boyhood Liverpool fan, and Shaun Cooper have joined as first-team coaches while Iraola’s long-time colleague Pablo de la Torre has arrived as assistant coach. Alejandro Rosalen has taken over as first-team goalkeeping coach after five years with Napoli. Continue reading...

items.title: Klopp starts Germany reign by threatening to quit
items.summary: Jurgen Klopp starts his reign as Germany's head coach by threatening to quit if the media invades his family's privacy.

items.title: Guardiola turns down Italy manager job
items.summary: Former Manchester City manager Pep Guardiola turns down the chance to coach Italy.

items.title: Le Real Madrid insiste pour Michael Olise et le Bayern de Vincent Kompany prépare sa riposte
items.summary: Impressionnant avec le Bayern Munich, Michael Olise attise les convoitises du Real Madrid. Face à la menace espagnole, le club bavarois anticipe et scrute le marché pour lui trouver un successeur.

items.title: L'Italie a trouvé son nouveau sélectionneur... et ce n'est ni Guardiola ni Ancelotti
items.summary: L'Italie a choisi Andrea Pirlo pour succéder au poste de sélectionneur. L'ancien champion du monde de 2006 devra relancer une Squadra Azzurra en perte de vitesse.

items.title: Philippe Albert zet meteen druk op Mark van Bommel én Belgische voetbalbond: "Ik verwacht een verklaring"
items.summary: Mark van Bommel is de nieuwe bondscoach van de Rode Duivels. In Vlaanderen was het géén verrassing dat er afscheid werd genomen van Rudi Garcia. Philippe Albert begrijpt de beslissing van de Belgische voetbalbond daar weer niet. Meer zelfs: de voormalige Rode Duivel eist een verklaring.

items.title: "Nous avons besoin de joueurs comme ça" : Paulo Fonseca est conquis par Julien Duranville
items.summary: Recruté cet été par Lyon pour relancer sa carrière après des blessures à Dortmund, Julien Duranville monte en puissance. Après des débuts hésitants, l'ailier belge a séduit son entraîneur contre Wolfsburg en match amical.

items.title: 'Al Hilal verdubbelt (!) bod van AS Roma en haalt Nederlands international naar Midden-Oosten'
items.summary: Crycencio Summerville gaat zijn sterk WK verzilveren. De 24-jarige Nederlander is onderweg naar Saoedi-Arabië om er een contract te tekenen bij Al Hilal SFC.

items.title: Niét wonen en leven in Knokke, maar deze troefkaart van Club Brugge overtuigde Yann Sommer
items.summary: Club Brugge heeft met Yann Sommer dé vervanger voor Simon Mignolet in huis gehaald. De concurrentie voor de 37-jarige doelman was nochtans niet min. De Belgische landskampioen gooide uiteindelijk dé ultieme troefkaart op tafel.

items.title: Chef Voetbal van BILD kondigt meteen volgende stap van De Cat aan: 'Bayern München kijkt van dichtbij mee'
items.summary: TSG 1899 Hoffenheim heeft de strijd om Nathan De Cat gewonnen. De subtopper troefde enkele Duitse en Engelse (top)clubs af. Al lijkt één andere club héél blij met de keuze van de éénvoudig Rode Duivel.
